title: Count Perfect Cubes in Array
statement:
You are given an array of `n` integers. Count how many elements of the array are **perfect cubes**.

An integer `x` is a perfect cube if there is an integer `k` with `k * k * k = x`. Zero and negative numbers can be perfect cubes (`0 = 0^3`, `-27 = (-3)^3`). Every position is counted separately, so repeated values are counted each time they appear.

Print the number of elements that are perfect cubes.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
The second line contains `n` space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print a single integer: the number of perfect cubes in the array.
hints: A negative number is a perfect cube exactly when its absolute value is, so you can work with `|x|`.
Compute an approximate integer cube root `r` of `|x|`, then test `r - 1`, `r` and `r + 1` by cubing them.
Do not rely on floating-point cube roots alone: values near 10^12 can round the wrong way, so always confirm with integer multiplication.
